lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular spots arranged in a non-uniform grid posterior to the gill slits, featuring approximately five vertical columns and four horizontal rows of primary maxima within the central flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a grid-like structure most discernible in the upper-mid section of the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible in the upper third of the flank, characterized by a transition from high-intensity pixels on the dorsal edge to a darker shadow gradient on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of multiple elongated, lower-luminance objects (ichthyofauna) is located ventral to the main body mass and posterior to the pectoral fin attachment point.
